Name: (CP and AT) Stone Floors
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[left][b][size=5][size=4][color=#00ff00]SDV 1.6 COMPATIBLE[/color]
[color=#e06666]Please do not redistribute or post this mod on any other sites. [/color][/size][/size][/b][b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7DxaSXe.png[/img]﻿[/b]
- a variety of replacement options for the original stone floor
- [b]designs available:[/b] A_Dark, B_Cool, B_LightBrown, B_Warm, C_Crystal, C_Snow, C_Dark, C_Pink
- now has AT version.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2oBiKnQ.png[/img]﻿
[b]﻿[/b]
Let's say you want to change the default design (which is A_Dark) to C_Snow, then go to config file and simply change the design option and dont
forget to[b] save [/b]after editing it.

[b]Configurations:[/b]
 
[color=#00ff00]"StoneDesign":[/color] "A_Dark",
[color=#00ff00]"Static":[/color] "True"
﻿
[color=#ffe599] [/color][color=#ffff00][color=#ffe599]"StoneDesign":[/color] [/color]"A_Dark"  ---> [color=#ffff00]﻿[color=#ffe599]"StoneDesign":[/color][/color][color=#ffe599] [/color]"C_Snow"

[b]Configurations:[/b]
 [color=#00ff00]"StoneDesign":[/color] "A_Dark",
[color=#00ff00]"Static":[/color] "True"
﻿[b]
[/b]If [i]you want to have different stone designs daily[/i], then you just need to edit:[b]
[/b]
[color=#ffe599]"Static":[/color] "False"[b]
[/b]
[color=#00ff00]﻿*Static:[/color] If Static is [u]"false"[/u], then the stone floor design will change daily. If it's [u]"true"[/u], you have to pick a design and type in "StoneDesign".
[color=#ffff00]*Note that[/color] when static is "true", stone floor design will not change daily.


[b]How to Install / Use[/b]
1. Make sure you have the requirements
2. Download, extract zip, and put the extracted file into your StardewValley/Mods folder
3. Run SMAPI once to generate the config.json.

[i]*If you want to change the default design, then:[/i]

4. Go to the mod's folder and open config.json using any text editor (Notepad, etc...)
5. Change the design according to your preferences.
